newsitem.title: USA: CFSB Bancorp declares 10 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: CFSB Bancorp declares 10 pct stock div.

text.p: CFSB Bancorp Inc, the holding company for Community First Bank, said Tuesday its board of directors declared a 10 percent stock dividend payable June 16 to stockholders of record on May 30.
Stockholders will receive one share of common stock for each 10 shares held. Fractional shares will be paid in cash based on the stock's market price on May 30.
CFSB said its next quarterly cash dividend will be paid on July 11. The company said it expects the current rate of $0.15 a share will remain in effect for both the current and new shares.
To date, the company said 47,900 shares were repurchased under a plan approved at its April 15 board of directors' meeting.
The company said it intends to reissue those shares and 161,600 shares repurchased in a prior program for the 10 percent stock dividend.

CFSB said the repurchase program was designed to offset the dilution expected from the company's stock option plans and the stock dividends. Under the plan, the company can acquire up to 235,000 shares, or about five percent of its outstanding common stock.
